notes:
Summary: covenant builds an on-prem / VPC-hosted RAG product for large law firms and regulators. Primary ask: scale embeddings index to tens of millions of documents (12M core docs for POC), sub-200ms p95 end-to-end for 1-stage search with reranking, target cost per interactive query < $0.02.

Key constraints: must run in customer-managed VPC or on-prem private deployment; immutable audit logs for every query and assistant turn; retention policy configurable up to 7 years and support for legal-hold; KMS/HSM integration required for document keys.

Behavioral needs: hybrid ANN + cross-encoder reranker pipeline; deterministic reranker versioning for reproducible results in audits; redaction and PII masking for transcripts; role-based access control tied to SSO/SAML groups.

technical_summary: POC architecture requested: stage 1 approximate nearest neighbor search over 12M doc vectors (HNSW / IVF), stage 2 cross-encoder reranker on dedicated low-latency instances for top-K (K=20). Target p95 latency <= 180ms for 1–2 competitors per user query; sustained 100 QPS with bursts to 500 QPS. Expect caching of popular prefixes, prefix/KV cache for chat flows, and smart batching for background embed updates. Index update cadence: nightly bulk + streaming for critical case updates. Cost constraints: business target < $0.02/query assuming 40% cache hit rate and efficient quantized models. Security: VPC-only egress, KMS-wrapped model weights optional, immutable query audit logs with append-only storage and retention policy enforcement.

Week 4: integrate cross-encoder reranker, measure rerank latency at K=20, tune quantization
Week 5: run scale test on 12M index (throughput & cost simulation), present cost per query model
